review:
Wild Cash is a shiny 3x3 slot with just five paylines and a big-money theme. Despite the classic look, BGaming rates it very high volatility.

The bonus game is triggered by three bonus symbols, and the feature itself awards a prize between 1x and 999x your total bet, with multipliers playing a part. Where permitted, you can buy the bonus game for 80x the bet. That price-to-range ratio means bought bonuses frequently return less than they cost. The game's maximum multiplier is 1,059x. The RTP is 96.23%. It's fast and simple, but the real-money swings are larger than the retro design suggests.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
